title: Briefing for 2026-11-18
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-18: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: St. Louis Fed's Musalem says four more rate hikes may be needed in coming months. Analysis: The Fed's chairman sees an AI revolution coming. Now he has to figure out what it means. Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite. AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds. Wholesale prices rose 0.3% in October, putting annual rate at 6.5%, the highest in nearly four years. UK economy expands 0.7% in third quarter as AI provides 'extra engine of growth'.
global: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine. How the attack on Crimean Bridge unfolded. Russian military plane crashes, killing all 19 on board. As Trump and Xi meet, China's AI dreams face an unexpected hurdle: the Nvidia spy scandal. Government backs welfare shake-up to prevent 'lost generation'. Rare images of Indigenous group in Amazon highlight threats, advocates say.
philippines: Nvidia says ‘no’ to rehiring Huang and WSJ reports SEC is probing the chipmaker. Cambridge Dictionary pushes back on AI with ‘human’ as 2026 Word of the Year. Bacolod anti-Pax Silica protest raises alarm over proposed copper mine. Marcos rolls out red carpet for Trump state visit.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
